data.one_liner: Customizable animated spinning wheel for Flutter with weighted odds and themes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable spinning wheel widget supporting weighted probabilities, server-decided results, swipe-to-spin interactions, and themed frames. It handles slice layouts, animations, and result callbacks out of the box.
use_when: You need a fortune wheel, prize wheel, or lucky draw feature in your app
You want a wheel that supports weighted odds or server-dictated landing results
avoid_when: Your application requires complex 3D physics simulations beyond standard 2D wheel spinning
strengths: Supports weighted odds and programmatic result targeting via `spinTo`
Includes built-in themes, frames, and touch interactions like swipe and tap-to-spin
Responsive design that scales cleanly to any size
